body:
maya: Heads-up — found a late ingest window for the legacy pipeline (events ~2026-03-14 03:00-05:00 UTC). Stitching gaps showing up in daily aggregates. Need a minimal replay plan and clear ops handoff.

sam: how big is the window? can we target specific shards?

maya: about 2 hours spread across 3 shards; likely due to the old S3 partitioning delay. shards: 12, 13, 19.

priya: if we do a full backfill it'll blow quota and CPU for the replayer. prefer targeted replays + prefix dedupe.

leah: agree. console needs a "targeted replay" checkbox + preflight estimate so ops know cost before kicking off.

ryan: we've got a preflight API already (POST /replay/preflight) but it doesn't surface token-cost or slot estimate for legacy schemas. we can augment it.

maya: ideal flow: 1) preflight for those three shards 2) dry-run replayer to compute duplicate keys 3) ops run replay with --dedupe and priority=lane:low-latency (so it goes to burst capacity).

sam: small note: priority lanes currently map to dedicated GPU pools. low-latency lane has limited quota; if we use it we should set a quota token override on the replay job.

priya: that's fine — we can gate by alerting the console if quota override > 0. ops should confirm override before start.

leah: UX ask — show per-shard token estimate and a toggle for "allow quota override" with a confirmation modal that lists potential impact on Dedicated capacity.

ops-bot: replay-dryrun scheduled for 1756004400, initiated by maya. Command: `/replay run --shards 12,13,19 --mode dry-run --since 2026-03-14T03:00Z --until 2026-03-14T05:00Z`

maya: leaving notes: when running full replay, ensure route policy fallback is enabled so if low-latency lane fills up it falls back to standard lane (no more than 2x latency). current policy: route.on_capacity_exhausted => fallback:standard.

ryan: small infra caveat — fallback currently doesn't preserve dedupe header; replayer needs to pass X-Idempotency-Key through both lanes.

priya: ok I'll add a quick patch to the replayer client to copy the header on fallback. low risk.

leah: ops checklist for handoff: confirm preflight numbers + set override + run dry-run + confirm no duplicates + schedule actual replay during maintenance window (opt out of spike autoscale).

maya: can someone own the handoff? I can coordinate but need on-call to approve override.

sam: I can own the handoff for the next 2h. I'll watch the console and escalate to on-call if preflight > 50k tokens.

ops-bot: preflight result (auto): shards 12/13/19 -> estimated tokens: [12k, 9k, 8k], total 29k. potential duplicates: ~1.4k ids.

maya: cool — that's within our soft limit. leaning to go for targeted replay with dedupe + priority lane override = 30k tokens. Sam will start.

priya: quick note for rollout: after job completes, run `SELECT count(*) FROM aggregates WHERE window='2026-03-14'` and compare to shadow output. If mismatch > 0.5% open a rollback ticket.

sam: starting dry-run now. will post updates. :thumbsup:

maya: thanks — keep updates here. if anything blocks, ping @oncall.

sam: dry-run done: duplicates detected 1,432, token estimate 29.2k. no fatal schema drift.

maya: proceed to actual replay in 10m. sam will run `/replay run --shards 12,13,19 --since 2026-03-14T03:00Z --until 2026-03-14T05:00Z --dedupe --priority override:30k`

ops-bot: replay job started (id: r-20260314-775). routing: low-latency -> fallback standard.

leah: monitoring: watching per-shard qps, token burn, and per-route latency panels. I'll post a short summary when finished.

sam: job finished. totals: tokens used 28,900; duplicates removed 1,418; no SLO breaches.

maya: thanks team. follow-ups: (1) replayer client patch to copy idempotency header on fallback (priya), (2) console preflight UX to include token breakdown per shard + override modal (leah), (3) doc the handoff checklist in runbooks (maya).

leah: I'll start the console mock and drop a design link here in 1h.

priya: I'll open a tiny PR for the header fix now.

maya: closing the loop — great job. filing a short postmortem in #postmortems if any follow-ups occur. :tada:
